agents.name: Router
agents.description: Classifies each arriving file (tabular / document / unsupported) and routes it to the right workflow.

agents.name: Privacy & Content Guard
agents.description: Deterministic PII detection/classification and prompt-injection scanning of file names and cells.

agents.name: Profiler
agents.description: Statistical profiling plus LLM semantic typing against the business glossary.

agents.name: Contract Steward
agents.description: Detects schema drift against the data contract, proposes rename mappings and new contracts (reviewed by the Critic).

agents.name: Critic
agents.description: Independent evaluator (evaluator-optimizer pattern) for mappings, contract proposals and remediation plans.

agents.name: Transformer
agents.description: Applies the contract (mapping, typing, rejects, dedupe); infers unknown date formats and VERIFIES them before use.

agents.name: Data Assurance
agents.description: Runs contract checks (volume, schema, quality, freshness, drift, reconciliation, privacy) and trips the circuit breaker.

agents.name: Publisher
agents.description: Masks PII per contract, stages immutable versions, publishes (blue/green) or quarantines.

agents.name: Correlator
agents.description: Clusters related signals into one incident per probable cause (time window + lineage), before any model reasons.

agents.name: Triage Supervisor
agents.description: Plans the investigation, fans out to specialists, merges findings and owns the final grounded diagnosis.

agents.name: Intake Investigator
agents.description: Read-only intake specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.

agents.name: Schema Investigator
agents.description: Read-only schema specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.

agents.name: Volume Investigator
agents.description: Read-only volume specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.

agents.name: Quality Investigator
agents.description: Read-only quality specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.

agents.name: Freshness Investigator
agents.description: Read-only freshness specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.

agents.name: Privacy Investigator
agents.description: Read-only privacy specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.

agents.name: Security Investigator
agents.description: Read-only security specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.

agents.name: Lineage Investigator
agents.description: Read-only lineage specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.

agents.name: Integrity Investigator
agents.description: Read-only integrity specialist: gathers evidence with tools and reports a cited finding.

agents.name: Impact Analyzer
agents.description: Walks lineage downstream to consumers, owners, SLAs and regulated outputs (blast radius).

agents.name: Remediation Planner
agents.description: Proposes remediation strictly from the allowlisted action catalog; plans are critiqued before policy evaluation.

agents.name: Executor
agents.description: The only agent holding write tools; executes approved/allowed catalog actions idempotently and records compensations.

agents.name: Verifier
agents.description: Verifies every executed action against ground truth; runs the saga compensation when verification fails.

agents.name: Learner
agents.description: Writes the blameless postmortem and proposes a lesson (episodic memory) and a regression eval case - humans curate both.

agents.name: Analyst
agents.description: Answers natural-language questions with read-only SQL over published datasets, through the semantic layer.

agents.name: Librarian
agents.description: Summarizes and classifies ingested documents for the knowledge base (untrusted until a human promotes them).

agents.name: Judge
agents.description: LLM-as-judge for explanation quality; must be calibrated against human labels before its scores are trusted.

tools.name: get_run_failure
tools.description: Why a run failed: failed step, error, dead-letter entry and file metadata.

tools.name: get_schema_diff
tools.description: Schema diff of an ingest run against its data contract (missing/new columns, rename candidates, mapping proposal).

tools.name: get_check_results
tools.description: Data-assurance check results for an ingest run (failed, warnings, passed).

tools.name: get_profile_comparison
tools.description: Column statistics of a run's batch versus the last published baseline.

tools.name: get_volume_history
tools.description: Batch row counts of recent versions of a dataset versus the baseline median.

tools.name: get_freshness_status
tools.description: Declared freshness SLA of a dataset and whether it is overdue.

tools.name: get_dataset_versions
tools.description: Recent immutable versions of a dataset with status and checksums.

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: Active data contract of a dataset.

tools.name: get_lineage
tools.description: Upstream or downstream lineage of a dataset (datasets and consumers).

tools.name: get_open_incidents
tools.description: Open incidents on datasets upstream of a dataset.

tools.name: get_signal_details
tools.description: Signals attached to an incident, including raw details (UNTRUSTED content).

tools.name: get_version_integrity
tools.description: Compare the published table's current checksum with the one recorded at publish time.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: BM25 search over runbooks and documents; results carry trust labels and citations.

tools.name: recall_similar_incidents
tools.description: Recall human-approved lessons from past incidents (episodic memory).

tools.name: get_sample_rows
tools.description: Sample of quarantined rows of a run (PII redacted, UNTRUSTED content).

tools.name: query_warehouse
tools.description: Run ONE read-only SQL SELECT over the tenant's published datasets (row-limited, authorizer-enforced).

tools.name: act_notify_owner
tools.description: Send the incident summary and evidence to an owner (email/chat outbox; URLs must be allowlisted).

tools.name: act_request_resend
tools.description: Ask the source owner to re-deliver a complete, current extract.

tools.name: act_quarantine_version
tools.description: Un-publish a published version; consumers fall back to the previous good version.

tools.name: act_hold_downstream
tools.description: Pause rebuilds of derived datasets so bad data does not propagate.

tools.name: act_release_hold
tools.description: Release held datasets so they rebuild.

tools.name: act_rollback_dataset
tools.description: Re-point a dataset to an earlier version, or restore the current version from its immutable snapshot.

tools.name: act_reprocess_with_mapping
tools.description: Re-run a quarantined batch with a column rename mapping.

tools.name: act_update_contract
tools.description: Create and activate a new contract version (add optional columns / aliases).

tools.name: act_force_publish
tools.description: Publish a quarantined version despite failed checks (like 'set to OK'). Highest risk.

workflows.name: ingest_file
workflows.description: One file from the watched folder: stage, route, read, fan out per sheet, archive.

workflows.name: ingest_dataset
workflows.description: One dataset batch (a CSV or one sheet): privacy, profile, contract, transform, data assurance, publish/quarantine.

workflows.name: document
workflows.description: Free-text document into the knowledge base (untrusted until promoted).

workflows.name: derive
workflows.description: Event-driven rebuild of a derived dataset, blocked when inputs are held or incident-bound.

workflows.name: triage
workflows.description: Incident triage swarm: investigate, diagnose, assess impact, plan, govern, act, verify, learn.

prompts.description: Natural language to read-only SQL over governed, published datasets.
Evaluator in an evaluator-optimizer loop; critiques mappings, contracts and remediation plans.
Infer the strptime format of date values that failed to parse with the contract formats.
Supervisor that merges specialist findings into one grounded root-cause diagnosis.
Candidate diagnoser prompt (stricter grounding); runs in shadow mode for comparison.
Read-only specialist investigator (ReAct tool loop) in the incident triage swarm.
LLM-as-judge for diagnosis explanations (v1 rubric; known to be biased toward long answers).
LLM-as-judge v2 rubric with explicit anti-verbosity instructions (calibrated against human labels).
Pairwise preference judge (used to measure position bias by swapping A/B).
Blameless postmortem + candidate lesson + candidate eval case from a closed incident.
Summarize and classify an ingested text document for the knowledge base.
Remediation planner; may only propose actions from the allowlisted action catalog.
Map physical columns to semantic types and business glossary terms.
Classify an arriving file as tabular data, a free-text document, or unsupported.
Propose an initial data contract for a new, unknown dataset (onboarding).
Propose source->contract column mappings for a schema drift (renamed columns).
